exposure: Prophylactic use of osmotic laxatives after cesarean section
cohort: 60 pregnant women who underwent a cesarean section at Hospital Santa Marcelina, São Paulo, Brazil, from October 2019 to March 2020.
finding: Prophylactic use of osmotic laxatives after cesarean section was associated with improved intestinal transit restoration and increased bowel movements without negative effects.
